item.title: Report: Raptors sign Kawhi Leonard to $115M extension
item.description: All-Star forward Kawhi Leonard has agreed to a two-year, $115 million contract extension with the Toronto Raptors, plus a player option for the 2028-29 season, ESPN reported on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: All-Star forward Kawhi Leonard has agreed to a two-year, $115 million contract extension with the Toronto Raptors, plus a player option for the 2028-29 season, ESPN reported on Tuesday. The report, citing Leonard's agent Harrison Gaines of Slash Sports, said Leonard has three years and $165 million on his deal with the Raptors, who re-obtained the player on Sept. 14 in a long-delayed trade from the Los Angeles Clippers. Leonard agreed to take $11 million less than his maximum contract extension amount as well as waive a $7.5 million trade kicker to come back to Toronto. The trade, initially agreed to on June 30, was officially signed off on by both teams after months of delay amid the NBA's investigation into Los Angeles allegedly giving Leonard impermissible benefits. In return for sending Leonard to Toronto, where in his lone season the Raptors won the 2019 NBA championship, the Clippers received forward Brandon Ingram, guard Gradey Dick, two unprotected first-round picks, one first-round pick swap and two second-round picks. Those acquired picks will help to replace the five first-round picks the league stripped from the Clippers for the $28 million "no-show job" the Clippers arranged for Leonard through one of their partners, Aspiration, in order to circumvent the salary cap. The NBA found the Clippers also made arrangements to pay Leonard through team partners Boingo Wireless, Daktronics and Lockton Insurance. Clippers owner Steve Ballmer announced Sept. 13 that he would accept the NBA's punishment, which included a one-year suspension and a $30 million fine along with the forfeited draft picks. Leonard, 35, averaged 25.1 points, 6.4 rebounds, 4.1 assists and 1.7 steals per game over 331 games (329 starts) across the past six seasons for the Clippers. He averaged a career-high 27.9 points in 65 regular-season games last season. The seven-time All-NBA player and two-time NBA Defensive Player of the Year was with the Raptors for just one very eventful season, where he anchored the first NBA title in franchise history before signing as a free agent with Los Angeles that offseason. Leonard has averaged 20.7 points, 6.4 rebounds, 3.1 assists and 1.7 steals over 798 games (769 starts) across 14 seasons with the San Antonio Spurs (2011-18), Raptors (2018-19) and Clippers (2019-26). He was voted the NBA Finals MVP in leading the Spurs (2014) and Raptors to titles. --Field Level Media

item.title: Belgium, Rwanda resume diplomatic relations after DRC conflict dispute
item.description: Belgium and Rwanda have resumed diplomatic relations 18 months after breaking ties due to a dispute over the conflict in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Belgium and Rwanda have resumed diplomatic relations 18 months after breaking ties due to a dispute over the conflict in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. Belgian Foreign Minister Maxime Prevot and Rwanda's foreign ministry both posted the news on X alongside photos of Prevot and his Rwandan counterpart Olivier Nduhungirehe in New York, where the United Nations General Assembly is taking place. The two countries expelled each other's diplomats in March 2025 as relations deteriorated over the conflict in Rwanda's neighbour. The AFC/M23 rebels control large parts of North and South Kivu provinces following their early 2025 advance, during which they captured Goma and Bukavu, eastern Congo's two largest cities. The UN and Western governments say the group is backed by Rwanda, which Kigali denies. Rwanda says it is defending itself against the threat from a Hutu militia, which it says is fighting with the Congolese military. Both DR Congo and Rwanda are former Belgian colonies. In a joint statement on Tuesday, Belgium and Rwanda said the two foreign ministers held a series of meetings and informal contacts over recent months, addressing a number of differences and misunderstandings "in a constructive spirit". They also thanked Qatar for facilitating a first meeting in June 2025 and said they planned to reopen their respective embassies soon. Prevot wrote on X that this was an important step "in a world marked by growing tensions". "Restoring diplomatic relations between states does not mean abandoning our position, but having structured channels for dialogue, and I will continue to defend the territorial integrity and sovereignty of the DRC," he said.

item.title: Smaller packs, more protein: AB InBev to adapt drinks to shifting tastes
item.description: Anheuser-Busch InBev will sell smaller pack sizes, beers with added protein or electrolytes and push further into drinks beyond beer, executives said on Tuesday, as the top brewer looks to grow amid shifting drinking habits, strained incomes and a trend towards health and wellness.
item.dc:creator: Emma Rumney
item.content:encoded: Anheuser-Busch InBev (ABI.BR) will sell smaller pack sizes, beers with added protein or electrolytes and push further into drinks beyond beer, executives said on Tuesday, as the top brewer looks to grow amid shifting drinking habits, strained incomes and a trend towards health and wellness. The world's largest brewer by market value will look to drive higher beer consumption and grow revenue from non-beer products like canned cocktails and energy drinks, executives told investors at a capital markets event. Brewers including AB InBev, which makes labels like Corona and Stella Artois, have been battling to grow beer volumes and revive weak demand in some large markets like the United States as some consumers cut back, prompted by pressure on their wallets or changing tastes. AB InBev Chief Marketing Officer Marcel Marcondes said one aim was to grow consumption among infrequent beer drinkers, with budget-conscious consumers in this category presenting the most significant opportunity. "Data is showing us huge opportunities to make beer more affordable, especially in developing markets," he said, adding AB InBev will address this by increasing both smaller pack sizes and larger ones offering higher quantities for less. Increasing non-alcoholic beer consumption during casual meals presented another major opportunity, he said, adding AB InBev would drive that via zero-alcohol beers with different flavours, low calories and even protein or electrolytes. The company has launched a version of its Spaten beer with added protein in Brazil. In the US especially, AB InBev has also been pushing into categories other than beer, including with top-selling canned cocktail label Cutwater and some energy drinks. Executives said it would expand further in these areas, with energy drinks alone potentially adding $25 billion to AB InBev's addressable market. "In this space, we are the challengers, which gives us huge headroom for growth," CEO Michel Doukeris said.

item.title: Trump promete “poderio militar sem igual” contra cartéis de drogas
item.description: O presidente norte-americano, Donald Trump, prometeu nesta terça-feira reafirmar o domínio dos EUA no Hemisfério Ocidental e utilizar “poderio militar sem igual” contra as ameaças na região, ao reunir aliados em torno de uma campanha cada vez mais ampla contra os cartéis de drogas.
item.dc:creator: Simon Lewis
item.content:encoded: O presidente norte-americano, Donald Trump, prometeu nesta terça-feira reafirmar o domínio dos EUA no Hemisfério Ocidental e utilizar “poderio militar sem igual” contra as ameaças na região, ao reunir aliados em torno de uma campanha cada vez mais ampla contra os cartéis de drogas. Ao se dirigir aos líderes mundiais na Assembleia Geral da ONU, Trump classificou os cartéis de drogas como “o Isis (Estado Islâmico) do Hemisfério Ocidental” e pediu uma resposta mais firme ao crime transnacional. Mais tarde, na sede da ONU, Trump se reuniu com líderes e ministros das Relações Exteriores de 14 países da América Latina e do Caribe que aderiram ao “Escudo das Américas”, uma coalizão anticartéis lançada por seu governo. Ele pediu ao grupo que se unisse aos EUA para designar 24 grupos narcotraficantes como ameaças à estabilidade e impor sanções contra eles. Os países emitiram posteriormente uma declaração comprometendo-se a tomar medidas no sentido dessas sanções conjuntas. A operação dos EUA que capturou o líder venezuelano Nicolás Maduro e um acordo petrolífero subsequente com o governo interino ressaltaram a disposição dos EUA de agir na região, disse Trump aos líderes mundiais na Assembleia Geral. “Nossas ações na Venezuela são prova de que os Estados Unidos não permitirão mais que ameaças à América ganhem espaço em qualquer lugar do Hemisfério Ocidental e, se necessário, usaremos nosso poderio militar sem igual para garantir os interesses nacionais vitais dos Estados Unidos”, afirmou. A Estratégia de Segurança Nacional de Trump, divulgada no final do ano passado, traçou planos para uma versão renovada da Doutrina Monroe — a política do século 19 que afirma a primazia dos EUA em todas as Américas e que os críticos há muito associam a décadas de intervenção norte-americana. O próprio Trump passou a chamá-la de “Doutrina Donroe”, um trocadilho com seu próprio nome, depois que a expressão ganhou popularidade na mídia conservadora. Trump também falou, muitas vezes em termos vagos, em retomar o Canal do Panamá e anexar a Groenlândia e o Canadá. Nesta terça-feira, ele assinou um acordo sobre a Groenlândia que não chega a atender à sua exigência de que a ilha se torne território dos EUA para conter a crescente presença da Rússia e da China no Ártico. Ainda assim, o foco de Trump no Hemisfério Ocidental tem suscitado preocupações quanto a um projeto neocolonial. O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, em seu discurso na ONU nesta manhã, reagiu com indignação a essa abordagem, alertando os países da América Latina e do Caribe sobre “novas tentações hegemônicas”. “O Brasil não é quintal de ninguém”, afirmou Lula. ESCUDO DAS AMÉRICAS O encontro do grupo Escudo das Américas foi a mais recente iniciativa dos EUA para mobilizar as nações latino-americanas em torno de uma abordagem mais agressiva, que incluiu ataques militares dos EUA a embarcações de contrabando de drogas desde o outono passado e maior cooperação com os países latino-americanos. Trump lançou o grupo em março, reunindo mais de uma dúzia de líderes regionais na Flórida. A coalizão inclui governos estreitamente alinhados com Trump, entre eles países como Argentina, Equador e El Salvador, cujos líderes Trump elogiou ou apoiou como candidatos. Colômbia e Peru aderiram depois que presidentes alinhados a Trump assumiram o poder nos últimos meses. Brasil e México estão entre os países que não aderiram. Desde que voltou ao poder no início do ano passado, Trump designou os cartéis de drogas como organizações terroristas estrangeiras e lançou dezenas de ataques mortais contra embarcações no Caribe e no Pacífico Oriental que, segundo autoridades norte-americanas, transportam narcóticos com destino aos EUA. Grupos de direitos humanos afirmaram que os ataques, que mataram mais de 220 pessoas, equivalem a execuções extrajudiciais. “Durante décadas, outros governos permitiram que grande parte desta região fosse dominada por gangues cruéis e cartéis de drogas sanguinários, desestabilizada pela migração descontrolada e infiltrada por adversários estrangeiros hostis – adversários estrangeiros doentios e dementes –, mas isso acabou”, disse Trump à ONU, acrescentando que estava “reafirmando o poder americano" para tornar a região mais segura ao eliminar os cartéis. “Assim como o Isis, eles devem ser mortos, exilados ou detidos como combatentes inimigos, sem possibilidade de libertação”, disse Trump, “e é isso que estamos fazendo”. Trump também destacou a campanha de pressão de seu governo contra a Cuba comunista, acusou seus líderes de fomentar grupos de esquerda “subversivos e radicais” nos Estados Unidos e disse que o secretário de Estado Marco Rubio estava “em negociações avançadas com Cuba”. Os cartéis de drogas que controlam territórios no México, vizinho dos EUA, eram “inaceitáveis”, disse ele, insistindo que o governo daquele país “precisa recuperar o controle de seu solo das mãos dos inimigos da humanidade”.

item.title: 米追加利上げ観測、企業の物価期待抑制が鍵に＝リッチモンド連銀総裁
item.description:
Howard Schneider
[ボルチモア ２２日 ロイター] - 米リッチモンド地区連銀のバーキン総裁は２２日、...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米追加利上げ観測、企業の物価期待抑制が鍵に＝リッチモンド連銀総裁 6:19 配信

米リッチモンド地区連銀のバーキン総裁。2025年4月撮影。REUTERS/Kevin Mohatt

Howard Schneider

[ボルチモア　２２日　ロイター] - 米リッチモンド地区連銀のバーキン総裁は２２日、米国の経済状況は「堅調さを増している」との認識を示した。個人消費が継続しているほか、人工知能（ＡＩ）投資ブーム以外でも力強さが見られるため、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）はインフレに焦点を当て続けていると述べた。

バーキン氏は、アナリストの業界団体であるＣＦＡ協会のボルティモア支部で行う講演原稿で「インフレのリスクは最大雇用のリスクを上回っている。それが先週の会合で利上げを実施した理由だ」と説明。２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げは、インフレ率をＦＲＢの目標である２％に戻すのに「役立つ」と述べた。

その上で「追加利上げが必要になるか、また何回必要になるかについては今後見極めていく」と語った。

バーキン氏の発言は、インフレに対する懸念を広げてきた他のＦＲＢ当局者らの見解に続くものだ。当局者らは、インフレが単にエネルギーや関税措置など、自然に解消されると予想される供給問題だけでなく、経済における強い需要によってますます押し上げられていると感じている。

また、企業が来年度予算や価格戦略を検討する際には、来年のインフレ見通しが重要な判断材料になると指摘。ＦＲＢによる利上げや追加利上げ観測が企業のインフレ期待を抑制し、物価上昇圧力を和らげる可能性があるとの見方を示した。

経済についても「過熱を主張するつもりはまだないが、経済は堅調さを増しており、弱まってはいない」と指摘。不確実性の時代を経て、企業や機関は投資・支出の判断をためらわなくなっているとの見方を示した。多くの企業は依然として価格決定力を持っていると感じているとも述べた。

総裁は、こうした「一時的な」ショックでさえ「短期間の単発的な出来事にとどまらず」、当初想定されていたよりも根強い物価上昇圧力を生み出していると指摘。

「中東紛争や関税措置の影響を特に強く受けているごく一部の品目が原因で高インフレが起きていると考えたくなる」が、個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）物価指数の多くの項目は年率３％を超えるペースで上昇していると述べた。

その上で「データセンター以外の分野でも勢いを感じている。防衛部門は活況を呈しており、製造業の関係者からはより楽観的な声が聞かれるようになってきた。銀行関係者からは、新規案件のパイプラインが堅調だと聞いている」と述べた。

労働市場については、「過熱しておらず、特に逼迫しているわけでもない」と指摘。消費者のバランスシートが過度に膨らんでいる証拠はあまり見られず、雇用市場が健全である限り消費者は支出を続けるとの認識を示した。

さらに足元の生産性向上については、その大部分がＡＩを反映しているとは考えていないと述べた。現在の局面については、１９９０年代の景気サイクル半ばの調整に似たものになると考えたいと語った。

金融環境については、ＦＲＢが細心の注意を払っているとしつつ、市場金利がインフレ抑制に必要な水準にとどまると想定することはできないと指摘。「きょうのイールドカーブが、あすのイールドカーブと同じになると当てにすることはできない」と述べた。

バーキン氏は今年の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で投票権を持たない。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：米景気拡大維持、ＦＲＢの利下げペース次第 アングル：米長期金利5％接近で株式市場に警戒感、決算後はマクロ要因に注目 焦点：ベセント氏発言で強まる日銀9月利上げ観測、米国の影響力拡大に懸念も アングル：米国債「ツイスト・スティープ化」、ＦＲＢの信認巡る懸念反映か アングル：インフレで揺らぐ債券のヘッジ機能、米投資家は実物資産に移行 最終更新: 9/23(水) 6:19 ロイター

item.title: Peso mexicano retrocede antes de decisión Banxico, bolsa extiende ganancias
item.description: El peso mexicano se debilitó el martes por la cautela previa a la decisión del Banco de México esta semana, en una sesión marcada por comentarios de funcionarios de la Reserva Federal que apuntaron a persistentes preocupaciones sobre la inflación en Estados Unidos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El peso mexicano se debilitó el martes por la cautela previa a la decisión del [USN:L6N45D0SW TEXT:"Banco de México"] esta semana, en una sesión marcada por comentarios de funcionarios de la [USN:L1N4580T6 TEXT:"Reserva Federal"] que apuntaron a persistentes preocupaciones sobre la inflación en Estados Unidos. Se espera que el banco central mexicano mantenga sin cambios su tasa de referencia el jueves, en contraste con el incremento al costo de los créditos que anunció la Fed la semana pasada, al tiempo que ofreció señales de nuevos ajustes en los próximos meses. * La moneda local cerró en 17.2720 unidades por dólar, con una depreciación de 0.32%, a medida que la [USN:L1N45E0UY TEXT:"divisa estadounidense"] subió en una volátil sesión, luego de haber alcanzado previamente un máximo de dos meses. * Los [USN:L6N45E0ZR TEXT:"precios del petróleo"], a su vez, descendieron por menores preocupaciones sobre el suministro, después de que el presidente [USN:L1N45E0KU TEXT:"Donald Trump"] afirmó ante la Asamblea General de la ONU que un acuerdo de paz con Irán podría llegar tras las legislativas estadounidenses a principios de noviembre. * [USN:L6N45E0V9 TEXT:"Tom Barkin"], presidente de la Fed de Richmond, dijo que la economía estadounidense podría estar consolidándose, por lo que la inflación sigue siendo un tema central, mientras que [USN:L6N45E0OC TEXT:"Susan Collins"], de la Fed de Boston, advirtió de mayores riesgos de que el indicador permanezca por encima de la meta del 2%. * El mercado local estará pendiente del anuncio de Banxico esta semana. Las estimaciones apuntan a que la [USN:L6N45D0SW TEXT:"tasa clave"] se mantendría estable al menos hasta la segunda mitad de 2028, por lo que analistas han dicho que el foco estará puesto en las perspectivas que ofrezca sobre la [USN:L1N45B01H TEXT:"trayectoria de la inflación"]. * La bolsa mexicana subió por segunda jornada consecutiva, luego de haber tocado su nivel más bajo en lo que va del año. El índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) ascendió un 1.45%, a 64,456.59 puntos, siguiendo un sólido desempeño de [USN:L6N45E114 TEXT:"Wall Street"]. * Los títulos del grupo aeroportuario OMA (OMAB.MX) encabezaron las alzas, con un 3.99% más a 222.68 pesos. Les siguieron los papeles del minero Grupo México (GMEXICOB.MX) , que avanzaron un 3.65% a 222.27 pesos. * En el mercado de deuda, los rendimientos primarios de los Certificados de la Tesorería (Cetes) registraron cambios mixtos en la subasta semanal de valores gubernamentales. La tasa del referencial Cete a 28 días fue colocada en un 6.15%, 10 puntos base por debajo de su remate previo.

item.title: North Korea's vice defence minister to visit Vietnam, KCNA reports
item.description: A delegation from the North Korean defence ministry, led by vice defence minister Ryo Chol Ung, left Pyongyang to visit Vietnam, the North Korean state media KCNA reported on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A delegation from the North Korean defence ministry, led by vice defence minister Ryo Chol Ung, left Pyongyang to visit Vietnam, the North Korean state media KCNA reported on Wednesday. The media did not elaborate on the purpose and schedule of the visit.

item.title: Em discurso de despedida na ONU, Macron chama diplomacia de Trump para Gaza de "espetáculo" vergonhoso
item.description: O presidente da França, Emmanuel Macron, rejeitou nesta terça-feira as alegações do presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, de que garantiu a paz em Gaza, afirmando que nenhum corredor humanitário havia sido reaberto no enclave, apesar da paz proclamada.
item.dc:creator: John Irish
item.content:encoded: O presidente da França, Emmanuel Macron, rejeitou nesta terça-feira as alegações do presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, de que garantiu a paz em Gaza, afirmando que nenhum corredor humanitário havia sido reaberto no enclave, apesar da paz proclamada. Em seu discurso final na Assembleia Geral das Nações Unidas antes de deixar o cargo no próximo ano, Macron disse que o mundo estava testemunhando um espetáculo que deveria envergonhar a todos, repreendendo a forma como Trump apresentou seu plano de paz para Gaza como um triunfo diplomático. Ele discursou na Assembleia Geral das Nações Unidas poucas horas após Trump, da mesma tribuna, ter saudado seu plano de paz para Gaza como um triunfo diplomático. “Há um ano, aqui mesmo neste salão, cerca de uma dúzia de países havia reconhecido a Palestina. Ouço o cinismo de algumas pessoas: ‘O reconhecimento é apenas um pedaço de papel, veja a realidade’”, disse Macron, batendo com o punho no pódio em seu último discurso na ONU antes de deixar o cargo, em maio próximo. “Mas que credibilidade temos se continuarmos inativos diante da situação em Gaza? Alguns se gabam de uma suposta paz. Mas essa paz não reabriu o acesso humanitário nem por um único segundo. Vamos simplesmente ficar parados assistindo a esse espetáculo que deveria envergonhar a todos nós?” A Casa Branca não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário. “Há um ano, quando me dirigi aos grandes líderes neste salão, a guerra em Gaza ainda se desenrolava brutalmente”, disse Trump em seu discurso. “Algumas semanas depois, pusemos fim à guerra em Gaza, salvando milhares e milhares de vidas.” Macron tem enfrentado críticas de alguns políticos e ativistas na França, acusando-o de ter feito pouco desde que reconheceu o Estado palestino, em setembro passado. Apesar das críticas, Paris endureceu sua postura em relação à violência dos colonos contra os palestinos na Cisjordânia, impondo algumas sanções nacionais e iniciando um processo para proibir produtos provenientes dos assentamentos israelenses na Cisjordânia ocupada. “Veja o que está acontecendo na Cisjordânia, onde todos os dias são cometidas violações. Em nome de quem? O Hamas nunca atuou na Cisjordânia”, disse Macron. “O que está acontecendo lá é a construção, dia após dia, da impossibilidade de um projeto que deveria se basear no respeito ao direito legítimo do povo palestino de existir.” As relações da França com Israel têm estado particularmente tensas ao longo do último ano. Macron afirmou que estão enganados os que acreditavam que violar a soberania de todos os vizinhos de Israel garantirá sua segurança. “Eles estão enfraquecendo a segurança de Israel, tanto hoje quanto no futuro”, disse. VIDA LONGA A sete meses da próxima eleição presidencial da França, Macron fez sua última aparição desde que subiu pela primeira vez à tribuna, em 2017. Macron alertou para um “retorno à lei da selva” global, afirmando que os países enfrentam uma escolha entre um mundo governado pelo poder e pela coerção e uma “sociedade internacional civilizada”. “Nosso dever, mais do que nunca, é estar ao lado das Nações Unidas. Não podemos aceitar a nova ordem de impunidade que alguns gostariam de construir”, disse ele. Ele encerrou seu discurso com “Vida longa às Nações Unidas!”

item.title: ＮＹ市場サマリー（22日）ナスダック連日最高値、ドル続伸 利回り低下
item.description: ＜為替＞ ドルが続伸して取引を終えた。原油価格の乱高下でインフレ見通しが不透明になる中、序盤に２カ月ぶりの高値を付けた後...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ市場サマリー（22日）ナスダック連日最高値、ドル続伸　利回り低下 6:13 配信

＜為替＞　ドルが続伸して取引を終えた。原油価格の乱高下でインフレ見通しが不透明になる中、序盤に２カ月ぶりの高値を付けた後、不安定な値動きが続いた。    原油価格は序盤、２週間ぶりの安値まで下落していた。イランが、米国が軍事的圧力を緩和し、イランの港湾封鎖を解除すれば、７日以内にホルムズ海峡を再開できると述べたことや、イランと米国が紛争終結に向けた交渉再開の可能性を示唆したことが手掛かりとなった。    しかし、トランプ氏が国連総会での演説で、１１月の中間選挙後にイランとの合意に達すると考えていると述べたことで、原油とドルが上昇。序盤の楽観的なムードは後退した。    ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、市場では米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による１０月会合での利上げを巡って見方がほぼ二分しており、少なくとも２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げ確率は５５．４％と、前日の５７．６％から低下している。    主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．１７％高の１００．５９。同指数は一時、７月３０日以来の高値となる０．２９％高の１００．７０を付けたものの、０．１１％下落する場面もあった。    ドルは対円では０．０３％高の１５７．４１円と、３営業日続伸となる勢い。日銀が１８日の金融政策決定会合で利上げを決定したにもかかわらず、円は圧力にさらされている。より慎重なペースを主張した政策委員２人の反対票について、市場は追加利上げの実施が難しくなる可能性を示唆していると受け止めている。    ユーロは０．１８％安の１．１４４１ドル。    英ポンドは０．２３％安の１．３３３２ドルと、２営業日続落の見通しとなった。過去７営業日で６回目の下落となる。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞　国債利回りが低下した。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が追加利上げを実施するか見極めようとする動きが続く中、この日はインフレ懸念の緩和につながる原油価格の下落に反応し、１０年債や２年債などの利回りが低下した。

終盤の取引で１０年債利回りは２．２ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下の４．９４１％。先週は５．０４１％と、２００７年以来の高水準を付けていた。

トランプ米大統領はこの日に国連総会で行った一般討論演説で、１１月上旬の中間選挙後に米国がイランと合意に達するとの見方を表明。その後、記者団に対し、米政府当局者がこの日にイラン代表団と約３時間にわたり「極めて良好な」協議を行ったと明らかにした。

これに関連してイラン国営メディアは、イランのアラグチ外相がこの日にニューヨークで米国のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使と会談し、戦略的要衝であるホルムズ海峡の通航再開に向けたイランの条件を米国に伝えたと報道。 米国時間の原油先物は下落し、北海ブレント先物は約１％安の１バレル＝９９．２５ドルで取引を終えた。

原油価格は対イラン軍事攻撃を受け急騰しており、インフレ加速と金利上昇に対する懸念が強まる要因になっていた。

米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は１５─１６日に開いた連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で、インフレ抑制を目的に２０２３年７月以来初めて利上げを決定。ＦＯＭＣに合わせて公表された金利・経済見通しでは、年内に少なくともあと１回の利上げが実施される可能性が示唆された。

ＣＭＥフェドウオッチによると、１０月２７─２８日の次回ＦＯＭＣで追加利上げが決定される確率は約５５％。

終盤の取引で、ＦＲＢの金融政策見通しに敏感な２年債利回りは２．５ｂｐ低下の４．７２８％。一時は４．７８７９％と、約２年ぶりの高水準を付けていた。

２年債と１０年債の利回り格差は２１．１ｂｐ。

３０年債利回りは１．５ｂｐ低下の５．２８１％。

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞　ナスダック総合が連日で終値での最高値を更新した。半導体大手マイクロン・テクノロジーや人工知能（ＡＩ）関連銘柄に買いが入り、ナスダック指数を押し上げた。また、原油価格が１バレル＝１００ドル近辺で推移する中、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種８月１３日に付けた過去最高値に迫った。

マイクロンは５％高、サンディスクは約７％高となった。

メタ・プラットフォームズが投入したＡＩアシスタント「ミューズ」の成功が、このところＡＩ関連半導体株への買いを後押ししている。

一方、ミューズが小売業者やオンライン証券会社など消費者向け企業と競合するとの懸念から、消費者向けソフトウエア株などに売りが広がった。

配車アプリ大手ウーバー・テクノロジーズとリフトはともに１％超下落。チャールズ・シュワブは６．１％安、民泊仲介大手エアビーアンドビーは３％安となった

原油先物は下落。トランプ米大統領が２２日の国連総会一般討論演説で、イランとの戦闘終結に向けた合意に至らなければ同国を「壊滅させる」可能性があると警告したことが材料視された。

市場では、２４日に予定されている米中首脳会談に注目が集まっている。

Ｓ＆Ｐ主要１１セクターのうち６セクターが下落。ＪＰモルガン・チェースとウェルズ・ファーゴがともに３％超下落する中、金融は１．６８％安となった。通信サービスも０．８％下落した。

Ｓ＆Ｐ５００種指数では、値上がり銘柄数と値下がり銘柄数はほぼ拮抗した。

米取引所の合算出来高は１７９億株と、直近２０営業日の平均である１６３億株を上回った。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞　米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の追加利上げ観測が意識され、金相場は下落。米東部時間午後１時４０分（日本時間２３日午前２時４０分）時点で、金現物は０．２％安の１オンス＝４３３６．２１ドル、米金先物の清算値は０．２％安の４３７６．４０ドルだった。トレーダーの間では１２月の利上げ確率が９０％と見込まれている。セントルイス連銀のムサレム総裁やシカゴ連銀のグールズビー総裁は、旺盛な需要とエネルギー価格上昇に起因するインフレを抑えるため、さらなる利上げの必要性を示唆した。金価格は１月に付けた過去最高値５５９４．８２ドルから２２％超下落している。高金利環境では金は利回りを生む資産に対して魅力が薄れるため、相場の重しとなっている。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞　サウジアラビアが東西パイプラインを再稼働させ、原油供給が拡大したことに加え、ホルムズ海峡を通る船舶の動きが活発化したことを背景に下落した。

北海ブレント先物の１１月限清算値は１．０９ドル（１．０９％）安の１バレル＝９９．２５ドル。

米ＷＴＩ先物の１０月限は２２日に取引最終日を迎え、１．１９ドル（１．２４％）安の９４．９９ドルで取引を終えた。

両指標とも取引時間中に２ドル超下落する場面もあった。

サウジアラビアによる東西パイプラインの操業再開により、西部の紅海沿岸のヤンブー港からの輸出は２２日中に再開する可能性がある。

ＮＹＭＥＸエネルギー：[CR/USJ]

item.title: US accounting firm Sorren is latest to add affiliated law firm
item.description: A national accounting firm that formed last year through the merger of 13 local firms said on Tuesday that it has expanded into legal services, marking the latest move in the accounting industry to create an affiliated law firm.
item.dc:creator: Sara Merken
item.content:encoded: A national accounting firm that formed last year through the merger of 13 local firms said on Tuesday that it has expanded into legal services, marking the latest move in the accounting industry to create an affiliated law firm. Private equity-backed Sorren said that lawyers at Sorren Law will handle transactional, succession planning, asset protection, estate planning and other legal work for businesses, investors and individuals. Sorren Law is a rebranded version of Mansfield & Mayo, a small law firm based in Nevada and Idaho. Big Four accounting firm KPMG [USN:L2N3PI15B TEXT:"launched"] a subsidiary law firm, KPMG Law US, in February 2025 after gaining approval from the top court in Arizona, where a program allows people who aren’t lawyers to have an economic interest in law firms. Accounting and advisory firm Aprio also launched a subsidiary law firm last year, Aprio Legal, under the Arizona program. The Sorren firm has a different setup. Sorren Law is owned by lawyers, not by Meridian, Idaho-based accounting and advisory firm Sorren. The accounting firm and the lawyers are co-invested in Sorren Legal Support, a management services organization that is a subsidiary of Sorren Inc, said Sorren Inc CEO Josh Tyree. The MSO provides administration and other back-end support services to the law firm, which will benefit from Sorren's investments in technology and other areas, he said. MSOs, used by the healthcare and accounting sectors for years, have generated interest in the legal industry as a way to split up the practice of law and the non-legal services and assets that support a law firm. An MSO can allow outside investment in a firm's business without violating professional ethics rules. Sorren Law has been hiring lawyers and plans to expand its services into new markets, Tyree said. Thirteen accounting firms came together last year to form Sorren, which is backed by New York-based private equity firm DFW Capital Partners. DFW did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

item.title: Oil price becoming increasingly important for ECB, Bundesbank chief says
item.description: Oil prices are an increasingly important indicator for ECB policymakers in setting interest rates but other factors also play a crucial role, Bundesbank President Joachim Nagel said on Tuesday after markets raised rate-hike bets on expensive energy.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Oil prices are an increasingly important indicator for ECB policymakers in setting interest rates but other factors also play a crucial role, Bundesbank President Joachim Nagel said on Tuesday after markets raised rate-hike bets on expensive energy. The ECB has already lifted its key rate twice this summer but investors see another three or four moves in the next year as both oil and gas prices are now at its "severe" scenario and inflation could peak at around 4%, twice the bank's target. ECB President [USN:L1N45A0DM TEXT:"Christine Lagarde"] and Vice President [USN:L8N4591NP TEXT:"Boris Vujcic"] have both pushed back on those bets, arguing that rates do not move in lockstep with oil prices. Their remarks suggested the bank may wait until December to pull the trigger next. "It's definitely not the only indicator but it's become a more relevant indicator over the last four years, this is for sure," Nagel told an event hosted by London's Society of Professional Economists. "It is obvious that we in governing council have to look at it and we have to take it into account when we take our decisions," he said about oil prices. Still, he kept open the door to more rate hikes. He said rates, now at 2.5%, are in a territory that neither restrict economic growth nor stimulate it. "I cannot exclude that if we are confronted with higher energy prices like this, that we have to go into the mild restrictive territory of monetary policy," he said. But he played down some worries about second-round inflation effects, arguing that the labour market was far softer than in 2022, when an energy-price-led inflation fuelled increasing wage demands, leading to a wage-price spiral. He also said there were no significant second-round effects in the data. For now, the ECB needed to maintain its approach of making decisions meeting by meeting, Nagel said. This means that policy needs to be somewhere between "constructive ambiguity," or intentional policy vagueness, and setting "forward guidance" or making explicit commitments about future policy moves, Nagel said.

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＥＣＢ政策判断、原油価格の重要性高まる＝独連銀総裁 6:07 配信

２０２４年６月撮影　REUTERS/Wolfgang Rattay

[ロンドン　２２日　ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのナーゲル独連銀総裁は２２日、エネルギー価格の高騰でインフレ率が目標を上回って推移していることを受け、ＥＣＢが金融政策を巡る判断を行うに当たり原油価格が一段と重要な指標になっているとの認識を示した。

ナーゲル氏はロンドンで開かれたイベントで、「（政策判断のための）唯一の指標では決してないものの、原油価格の重要性は過去４年間で確実に高まっている」と指摘。「ＥＣＢ理事会が原油価格に注視し、政策決定を行う際に考慮しなければならないのは明らかだ」と語った。

労働市場の動向については、それほど懸念していないと述べた。

item.title: Packers RT Zach Bako-Bewele (knee) out for season
item.description: Green Bay Packers right tackle Zach Bako-Bewele will miss the rest of the season with a torn patellar tendon.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Green Bay Packers right tackle Zach Bako-Bewele will miss the rest of the season with a torn patellar tendon. The 27-year-old veteran, formerly known as Zach Tom, was carted off the field early in Sunday's win over the New York Jets. Bako-Bewele told reporters Tuesday that he sustained a complete tear of the same tendon he partially tore last season. He is facing another surgery and a lengthy rehabilitation. Drafted in the fourth round by the Packers in 2022, Bako-Bewele has appeared in 57 career games (53 starts). He signed a four-year, $88 million contract extension in July 2025. Second-year lineman Anthony Belton is expected to replace Bako-Bewele in the lineup, starting when the Packers (1-1) play their home opener Thursday night against the Atlanta Falcons (0-2). --Field Level Media

item.title: Soja recua em Chicago enquanto operadores acompanham reunião entre EUA e China
item.description: Os contratos futuros de soja negociados na bolsa de Chicago fecharam em baixa nesta terça-feira, em uma reversão dos fortes ganhos registrados na segunda-feira, enquanto os operadores aguardavam uma cúpula entre os EUA e a China, principal importadora.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os contratos futuros de soja negociados na bolsa de Chicago fecharam em baixa nesta terça-feira, em uma reversão dos fortes ganhos registrados na segunda-feira, enquanto os operadores aguardavam uma cúpula entre os EUA e a China, principal importadora. Os preços mais baixos do petróleo contribuíram para criar um clima negativo no mercado, segundo os operadores. A Sinograin, empresa estatal chinesa responsável pelo armazenamento de grãos, anunciou seu segundo leilão em grande escala de soja importada em setembro, poucos dias antes da cúpula em Washington. Os operadores afirmaram que as vendas tinham como objetivo liberar capacidade de armazenamento para as chegadas previstas de soja dos EUA. Eles esperam que a cúpula entre os líderes nesta semana traga maior clareza sobre a demanda futura da China por soja dos EUA. Os operadores aguardavam para ver se a China poderia remover o imposto de importação de 10% sobre a soja dos EUA, que tem desestimulado compradores privados chineses a realizar compras. A soja novembro fechou em baixa de 2,5 centavos, a US$13,255 por bushel. O mercado havia se aproximado anteriormente de uma máxima de quase três anos, registrada em 11 de setembro. Assim como a soja, o contrato de milho dezembro na CBOT fechou em baixa de 6,25 centavos, cotado a US$5,3675 por bushel. (Reportagem de Tom Polansek)

item.title: Jets sign QB Will Levis to practice squad
item.description: The New York Jets signed former Tennessee Titans starting quarterback Will Levis to the practice squad on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The New York Jets signed former Tennessee Titans starting quarterback Will Levis to the practice squad on Tuesday. In the corresponding move, the Jets released quarterback Bailey Zappe from the practice squad. Starter Geno Smith and rookie Cade Klubnik are the quarterbacks on New York's active roster. The Titans released Levis, 27, at the end of the preseason on Aug. 30 and he went unclaimed on waivers. Levis started 21 games for the Titans after being drafted No. 33 in 2023, completing 61% of his passes for 3,899 yards, 21 touchdowns and 16 interceptions. He had a 5-16 record as a starter and spent last season recovering from right shoulder surgery after being unseated as the starter by 2025 No. 1 overall pick Cam Ward. Tennessee, which moved up eight spots to draft Levis with the first pick in the second round, signed Mitchell Trubisky to a two-year contract in March and gave the veteran most of the work behind Ward during training camp. Zappe, 27, has played in 15 games (nine starts) and completed 62.1% of his passes for 2,223 yards, 12 TDs and 14 interceptions. The New England Patriots selected Zappe in the fourth round of the 2022 NFL Draft. In other moves, the Jets signed linebacker Troy Reeder to the 53-man active roster and signed linebacker Jaden Keller to the practice squad. Reeder, 32, was elevated from the practice squad for Sunday's game against the Green Bay Packers and played 25 snaps on special teams. He has played in 107 regular-season games (38 starts) for the Los Angeles Rams (2019-21, 2023-25), Los Angeles Chargers (2022) and Jets. Keller, 23, an undrafted rookie out of Virginia Tech who signed with New York in May, was released from the practice squad on Sept. 15. --Field Level Media

item.title: Reports: Giants QB Jaxson Dart (knee) could miss rest of 2026 season
item.description: New York Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart faces the possibility of season-ending knee surgery as a result of a hit in Monday's loss to the Los Angeles Rams, according to multiple reports.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: New York Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart faces the possibility of season-ending knee surgery as a result of a hit in Monday's loss to the Los Angeles Rams, according to multiple reports. Dart was hit on his right side by Rams outside linebacker Byron Young and the force propelled him in the direction of Rams linebacker Josaiah Stewart. Dart went to the ground grabbing for his left knee as medical personnel came to his side, and he left the game during New York's first offensive series. "Evaluations are ongoing," Giants coach John Harbaugh told reporters Tuesday. "We haven't got any final decisions yet. We've learned a lot more. ..." Asked if Dart could miss the season, Harbaugh said, "I don't think I could really comment on that right now until we know for sure what's going to transpire." Initial tests Monday night created optimism Dart, 23, avoided a major knee injury. Harbaugh said after the 28-6 loss to the host Rams that it was "in the neighborhood" of a sprained medial collateral ligament. But more testing Tuesday -- including an MRI exam -- after the Giants returned to New Jersey detected more significant damage. "I'm not sure exactly what news or how anything's been stated, but right now I'd say evaluations are ongoing," Harbaugh said. "We haven't got any final decisions yet. We've learned a lot more, I wouldn't really want to share too much until decisions get made. That takes more than one person, takes everybody involved. So, when we know you know what direction we're going to have to go or go or whatever it might be, we'll announce that but we don't have that yet. So, I don't want to get out over our skis on that." Harbaugh said he won't speculate on the seriousness of Dart's injury. "That's what you do, but you've got to put yourself in my shoes, that's not my job," Harbaugh said. "I'm not a media person and I just can't do that. It's not the right thing to do, it's when decisions get made and we know which direction we're going to go, then heck yeah, we'll let everybody know what they are. But until that happens, I can't breach those conversations. "That's trust that you have with people, and I don't even know all the answers because I'm not the person who's hurt. So, I'm not the doctor, either, so I'm privy to it. I kind of know some of it, I don't know all of it and I certainly am not in position to be reporting on it." Dart was replaced in the game by Jameis Winston, who completed 11 of 27 passes for 111 yards. He also threw an interception. Dart was the 25th overall pick in the 2025 draft. He's currently 31st in the NFL with 250 passing yards and tied for 14th with three TD passes, all in New York's Week 1 win over the Dallas Cowboys. New York could contemplate acquiring a quarterback. Current offensive coordinator Matt Nagy has worked closely with current NFL backups Mitchell Trubisky (Titans) and Justin Fields (Chiefs) when he was head coach of the Chicago Bears. "Absolute faith in all our players," Harbaugh said when asked about Winston. "That's why all the guys are here. Jameis is one of our guys who obviously is here for a reason. He's a very good football player." The Giants (1-1) host the Tennessee Titans (0-2) on Sunday. --Field Level Media

item.description: ［ニューヨーク ２２日 ロイター］ - 米国株式市場では、ナスダック総合が連日で終値での最高値を更新した。半導体大手マ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場＝ナスダック連日最高値、ＡＩ関連株高で 　米中首脳会談に注目 6:01 配信

2012年7月、ニューヨークのナスダックビル前で撮影。REUTERS/Brendan McDermid

［ニューヨーク　２２日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場では、ナスダック総合が連日で終値での最高値を更新した。半導体大手マイクロン・テクノロジーや人工知能（ＡＩ）関連銘柄に買いが入り、ナスダック指数を押し上げた。また、原油価格が１バレル＝１００ドル近辺で推移する中、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種８月１３日に付けた過去最高値に迫った。

マイクロンは５％高、サンディスクは約７％高となった。

メタ・プラットフォームズが投入したＡＩアシスタント「ミューズ」の成功が、このところＡＩ関連半導体株への買いを後押ししている。

一方、ミューズが小売業者やオンライン証券会社など消費者向け企業と競合するとの懸念から、消費者向けソフトウエア株などに売りが広がった。

配車アプリ大手ウーバー・テクノロジーズとリフトはともに１％超下落。チャールズ・シュワブは６．１％安、民泊仲介大手エアビーアンドビーは３％安となった

原油先物は下落。トランプ米大統領が２２日の国連総会一般討論演説で、イランとの戦闘終結に向けた合意に至らなければ同国を「壊滅させる」可能性があると警告したことが材料視された。

市場では、２４日に予定されている米中首脳会談に注目が集まっている。

テミス・トレーディングの株式市場構造調査責任者、ジョー・サルッツィ氏は「対立を続けるのではなく、何らかの国際的な枠組みを構築できる可能性について、少なくとも対話を始めることが求められている」と述べた。

Ｓ＆Ｐ主要１１セクターのうち６セクターが下落。ＪＰモルガン・チェースとウェルズ・ファーゴがともに３％超下落する中、金融は１．６８％安となった。通信サービスも０．８％下落した。

Ｓ＆Ｐ５００種指数では、値上がり銘柄数と値下がり銘柄数はほぼ拮抗した。

米取引所の合算出来高は１７９億株と、直近２０営業日の平均である１６３億株を上回った。

item.title: Trading Day: Oil slips, Nasdaq rips
item.description: The Nasdaq sailed to a new a high on Tuesday, lifted by a wave of positive momentum around the AI outlook and another decline in global oil prices, while investors turned their attention to the US-China leaders' summit in Washington later this week.
item.dc:creator: Jamie McGeever
item.content:encoded:
The [USN:L6N45E0DU TEXT:"Nasdaq"] sailed to a new a high on Tuesday, lifted by a wave of positive momentum around the AI outlook and another decline in global [USN:L1N45E004 TEXT:"oil"] prices, while investors turned their attention to the US-China leaders' summit in Washington later this week. In [USN:L6N45C084 TEXT:"my column today"], I look at the US-China artificial intelligence arms race, and what's behind the sudden outbreak of apocalyptic warnings about the technology's threat to mankind. These warnings have proliferated just as worries are deepening that China's cheaper AI will expose the expensive US model as highly uneconomical. Today's Key Reads [USN:L8N45E0CI TEXT:"Trump says Iran deal nearing, Tehran offers Hormuz reopening"] [USN:L4N4590VX TEXT:"As Trump and Xi meet, investors play both sides of AI divide"] From smart glasses to AI pins, privacy fears challenge tech's next big bet [USN:L6N45D0VX TEXT:"Losing the plot? Warsh's Fed more 'touchy-feely' than data-driven: Mike Dolan"] Corporate bond buyers get picky with flood of AI debt Today's Key Market Moves STOCKS: Nasdaq +0.5% to new record high, S&P 500 flat, Dow -0.4%. [USN:L4N45E0B8 TEXT:"Europe"] flat, [USN:L6N45E0BZ TEXT:"UK"] -0.3%. SECTORS/SHARES: Five sectors on the S&P 500 rise, six fall. Materials +2%, financials -2%. Chip stocks +2%. SanDisk +7%, Micron Technology +5%. GoDaddy, Charles Schwab -6%. FX: [USN:L1N45E00E TEXT:"Dollar"] edges up to 7-week high. [USN:L4N45E035 TEXT:"South Korean won"] up 1.3%, best day in a month. BONDS: Treasuries little-changed across the curve. 2-year auction pretty soft, despite highest yield since May 2023. COMMODITIES/METALS: [USN:L1N45E004 TEXT:"Oil"] falls for fifth day, longest losing streak since August last year. Average US diesel up to new high $6.5276 a gallon. [USN:L4N45E01B TEXT:"Gold"] slips.

Today's Talking Points: Gotta get a message to you After the flurry of major central bank decisions over the last 10 days comes the even bigger flurry of policymaker speeches, interviews, and media appearances. Do market expectations move all that much from where they were the day of these decisions and press conferences by chiefs Warsh, Lagarde, Ueda and Bailey? Not really, because the general consensus views and likely policy paths, such as they exist, have already been laid out. There are 19 Fed policymakers (although only 12 voters at any one time), and 27 ECB rate-setters - that's a lot of commentary for investors to ignore. The BoE and BOJ's nine-strong policymaking committees are positively lean by comparison. Investors are more likely to take their lead in the coming days from elsewhere - fresh economic data, corporate developments, geopolitics, Middle East energy supply shifts. Oil slick Global oil prices are back below $100 a barrel, with Brent and WTI crude futures falling on Tuesday for a fifth straight day. That's the longest downward streak for both benchmarks in over a year. Could the market be at a turning point? Has the second oil shock of the Iran war come and gone? It would probably be unwise to be too confident, but [USN:L8N45E0CI TEXT:"a peace deal in the offing"] and more supply potentially coming back onto the market could have a significant impact. All that is hypothetical right now. Oil is still up 50% from a year ago, and analysts estimate that up to half of the US inflation overshoot is down to elevated energy and commodity prices. But a sustained decline would wipe much of that away, and call into question the recent strengthening of market rate hike expectations - and policymaker signaling - across much of the developed world. Disunited Nations The United Nations General Assembly is in full flow, with nearly 130 world leaders gathered in New York. That's not a great turnout, which may reflect the old world order of multilateralism, globalization and cross-border cooperation gradually giving way to one characterized more by nationalism, bilateral agreements and de-globalization. The biggest 'no-show' is Chinese President Xi Jinping, who will meet Trump in Washington later this week. Trump addressed the UN assembly today (prompting a walkout by the Cuban delegation), and UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres gave his final address, in which he called for greater curbs on AI. One wonders how many world leaders will be showing up at the annual jamboree in 5 or 10 years' time (presuming AI hasn't wiped out mankind by then). What could move markets tomorrow? item.title: Cacau se recupera de mínimas de várias semanas; açúcar bruto também avança
item.description: Os contratos futuros do cacau se recuperaram nesta terça-feira, após atingirem mínimas de sete semanas e meia no início do pregão, enquanto o açúcar bruto também voltou a subir, depois de cair para uma mínima de 4 semanas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os contratos futuros do cacau se recuperaram nesta terça-feira, após atingirem mínimas de sete semanas e meia no início do pregão, enquanto o açúcar bruto também voltou a subir, depois de cair para uma mínima de 4 semanas. CACAU * O cacau de Londres fechou com alta de £37, ou 0,9%, a £3.998 por tonelada métrica. O mercado havia registrado, anteriormente, uma mínima de 7 semanas e meia, de £3.799. * Os corretores afirmaram que a recente fraqueza foi impulsionada pelo excesso de oferta, embora se espere um mercado mais equilibrado na safra de 2026/27, com a produção global prevista para cair. * A precipitação ficou abaixo da média na semana passada na maioria das principais regiões produtoras de cacau da Costa do Marfim, e os agricultores afirmaram na segunda-feira que as condições de seca poderiam ameaçar o desenvolvimento das pequenas vagens que devem ser colhidas no próximo ano, durante a safra principal, que vai de setembro a fevereiro. * O contrato futuro de cacau de Nova York subiu 1%, para US$5.402 por tonelada, após atingir uma mínima de 7 semanas e meia, de US$ 5.111. AÇÚCAR * O açúcar bruto fechou com alta de 0,11 centavo, ou 0,6%, a 17,59 centavos por libra-peso, após atingir uma mínima de 4 semanas de 17,11 centavos. * Operadores afirmaram que a retração do mercado em relação à máxima de 16 meses de 18,88 centavos, registrada em 10 de setembro, ainda pode se aprofundar, embora as perspectivas sejam mais positivas no médio a longo prazo, com o fenômeno climático El Niño previsto para prejudicar a produção e, potencialmente, levar a um déficit global na safra de 2026/27. * O preço do açúcar branco permaneceu praticamente inalterado em US$507,90 por tonelada, após atingir uma mínima de US$496,80, a menor cotação em 6 semanas e meia. CAFÉ * O café arábica fechou em queda de 4,1 centavos, ou 1,5%, a US$2,723 por libra-peso, após atingir uma mínima de três meses de US$ 2,7130. * Os corretores afirmaram que as condições climáticas favoráveis à safra nos principais países produtores, Brasil e Vietnã, contribuíram para a recente desvalorização. * Eles observaram, no entanto, que a atividade no mercado físico no Brasil começou a ser afetada, já que os produtores se abstiveram de vender mais grãos aos preços atuais. * O café robusta recuou 2,3%, para US$3.260 a tonelada. O mercado havia atingido, anteriormente, uma mínima de mais de três meses, de US$ 3.245. (Reportagem de Nigel Hunt e Marcelo Teixeira)

item.title: トランプ氏、7月にスペースＸ株購入 一部売却＝財務開示
item.description:
Courtney Rozen
[ワシントン ２２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領が７月、実業家イーロン・マスク氏...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
トランプ氏、7月にスペースＸ株購入　一部売却＝財務開示 5:58 配信

2025年7月1日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo

Courtney Rozen

[ワシントン ２２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領が７月、実業家イーロン・マスク氏率いる宇宙開発企業スペースＸの株式を最大５万ドル相当購入し、その後一部を売却していたことが、公開された財務開示報告書で明らかになった。

トランプ氏が９月８日に署名した財務開示報告書によると、７月１０日に１万５００１─５万ドル相当のスペースＸ株を購入し、同月１７日に１００１─１万５０００ドル相当を売却した。

今回の取引により、政権が同社の事業に影響を及ぼし得る判断を行う中、トランプ大統領とスペースＸとの間に新たな金銭的つながりが生じたことになる。

スペースＸは米軍の主要請負業者で、事業運営に関して連邦政府機関の承認や認可を頻繁に必要としている。

スペースＸは６月１２日にナスダック市場に上場。初日の終値は新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）価格の１３５ドルを約１９％上回り、時価総額は約２兆１０００億ドルに達した。これにより、マスク氏は史上初の「トリリオネア（１兆ドル長者）」となった。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：トランプ政権の影で歩み寄るカナダとＥＵ、準加盟提示でも見える限界 コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 アングル：トランプ氏の「信任投票」化戦略、共和党内に懐疑論も アングル：米保守活動家カーク氏暗殺から1年、設立団体拡大も若年層にトランプ離れ アングル：米中間選挙が事実上の最終盤入り、トランプ氏の共和党に暗雲 最終更新: 9/23(水) 5:58 ロイター

item.title: EQT sees higher 2026 US natgas output on lower spending, CEO says
item.description: EQT , the second-biggest US natural gas producer, plans to pull more gas out of the ground in 2026 while spending less money than last year to meet growing global demand, CEO Toby Rice told Reuters on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Scott Disavino
item.content:encoded: EQT (EQT.N) , the second-biggest US natural gas producer, plans to pull more gas out of the ground in 2026 while spending less money than last year to meet growing global demand, CEO Toby Rice told Reuters on Tuesday. He said record production will come despite curtailed production in recent months by EQT and others in the Marcellus and Utica shale regions of Pennsylvania, Ohio and West Virginia. The producers are waiting for gas prices in the region to rise. "We have a shut-in program. During times of low prices, we sell less. When prices are higher, we sell more," Rice said. "Having a business that's able to throttle the production aligned with what the market requires ... is one of the reasons we've been able to beat our pricing expectations," Rice said. He said EQT has benefited by a little over $200 million a year from its ability to sell less gas when prices are low and more when prices are high. In its second-quarter earnings in July, EQT (EQT.N) reduced 2026 maintenance capital spending guidance by $25 million to a range of $2.040 billion to $2.190 billion. It boosted its production guidance for the year by 0.25 billion cubic feet of gas equivalent per day (bcfed) to an average of 6.5 to 6.7 bcfed. That compares with spending of of around $2.324 billion in 2025 to produce an average of 6.5 bcfed. One billion cubic feet is enough gas to supply about five million US homes for a day. On average, the US consumed a record 91.9 billion cubic feet per day (bcfd) of gas in 2025 and exported a record 24.6 bcfd as liquefied natural gas to the world or via pipelines to Mexico and Canada, according to the US Energy Information Administration (EIA). The EIA and other analysts expect US gas use to keep hitting record highs in coming years as demand surges to power data centers and for export as LNG and by pipeline. NEW OPORTUNITES "We're really pushing to find ways to expand demand for Appalachian molecules," Rice said. In August, EQT launched an open season for its proposed POWER pipeline project to move up to 1.0 bcfd of gas about 50 miles (80 kilometers) from Pennsylvania to Ohio, where several firms plan to build or expand power-hungry data centers running artificial intelligence. EQT told prospective customers the pipe could enter service in January 2030 and Rice said the POWER pipe could move more than 1.0 bcfd depending on demand. In addition to the proposed POWER pipe, EQT has been expanding its 2.0-bcfd Mountain Valley Pipeline from West Virginia to Virginia. That project, known as MVP Boost, is on track to add about 0.6 bcfd of capacity to the mainline in 2028. The MVP Southgate project is on track to start moving about 0.55 bcfd of gas from Virginia to North Carolina starting in late 2026. On Monday, EQT signed a 10-year deal to supply about one LNG cargo per year to Lithuania's majority state-owned energy firm Ignitis. "We're incredibly bullish on the international markets," Rice said. He said EQT sees gas demand growing through 2040 by around 20 bcfd in domestic markets and by around 200 bcfd in international markets. EQT will have about 6 million tonnes per year of LNG (roughly 0.8 bcfd of gas) available to sell around 2030-2031 when some LNG export plants under construction and development enter service, including NextDecade's (NEXT.O) Rio Grande in Texas, Sempra's (SRE.N) Port Arthur in Texas and Caturus' Commonwealth in Louisiana. That is about 15% of the company's gas portfolio.

item.title: Black Foils focus on future after tough SailGP season
item.description: Black Foils co-CEO Blair Tuke said the New Zealand team are building for the future, including protecting the oceans fundamental to their sport, as they near the end of what he said had been a "really tough" SailGP season.
item.dc:creator: Alexander Smith
item.content:encoded: Black Foils co-CEO Blair Tuke said the New Zealand team are building for the future, including protecting the oceans fundamental to their sport, as they near the end of what he said had been a "really tough" SailGP season. A [USN:L4N3ZC07T TEXT:"high-speed crash"] with France in front of New Zealand's home crowd in February resulted in the team's sailors being shore bound for months and [USN:L4N3ZE0XE TEXT:"missing"] four events while SailGP built a replacement for their F50 catamaran, which was beyond repair. "It's been a really tough one is probably the only way to put it. We had four months when we didn't sail or race as a team," Tuke told Reuters in a recent interview. "It's a mix now. We're obviously trying to build for next season and develop, but probably the best way to do that is to try and put your best foot forward and to race well and put yourselves under pressure," the 37-year-old wing trimmer added. With no prospect of reaching November's grand final in Abu Dhabi, the team are also working on developing new talent. "The season's out of reach," Tuke said, adding that Black Foils, who now lie 12th on the season leaderboard, were aiming to "win race weekends and build processes and experience that sets us up for the future". Tuke is a fan of the new group racing format that splits SailGP's now 13-strong fleet in two, partly as a precaution aimed at avoiding clashes like the dramatic one in Auckland. "It had to happen at some point as SailGP grew and I think following some of the incidents that happened earlier this year it maybe got fast-tracked a little quicker," he said. 'MUCH BIGGER THAN OURSELVES' Tuke said New York-based MSP Sports Capital's [USN:L8N42R0OS TEXT:"acquisition of a majority stake"] in the Black Foils gives them a "really exciting opportunity", both on and off the water. "We're so focused on becoming a global sports brand that represents New Zealand on the world stage, that pushes what's possible on the performance side," said Tuke, adding that the team is also targeting "something much bigger than ourselves". Having MSP's backing has 'supercharged' the team's ability to achieve all those things, said Tuke, partly with reference to the Live Ocean Foundation he founded with co-CEO and longtime sailing partner Pete Burling in late 2019. "The ocean is declining fast and its health is key to our future on this planet," Tuke said of the campaigns which Live Ocean has launched in New Zealand to "bring people round to issues they otherwise wouldn't be made aware of". "We've got the platform in sport to do something," he said, adding that he and Burling had wanted to be able to integrate their campaigning into something that they did every day. For Tuke, establishing the team's Live Ocean partnership was a "non-negotiable" in discussions with SailGP, which runs its own impact league among teams, from the outset. "I am very committed to making sure we leave this place in a better state than when I came into it," he said.

item.title: 米ＦＲＢの金融政策ツールキット「非常に効果的に機能」＝ＮＹ連銀高官
item.description:
Michael S. Derby
[ニューヨーク ２２日 ロイター] - 米ニューヨーク連銀で金融政策の執行を担うロベ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ＦＲＢの金融政策ツールキット「非常に効果的に機能」＝ＮＹ連銀高官 5:56 配信

米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）ビル。2025年9月撮影。REUTERS/Ken Cedeno

Michael S. Derby

[ニューヨーク　２２日　ロイター] - 米ニューヨーク連銀で金融政策の執行を担うロベルト・ペルリ氏は２２日、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金融政策のツールキットは引き続き非常に効果的に機能しているとの認識を示した。

ニューヨーク連銀が主催した米国債市場に関する会合の閉会あいさつでペルリ氏は「われわれは非常に強固な金利コントロールを維持し、準備預金を潤沢な水準の範囲内に保ってきた。財務省短期証券（Ｔビル）買い入れも円滑に進んでいる」と語った。同氏は、ＦＲＢの資産ポートフォリオ「システム・オープン・マーケット・アカウント（ＳＯＭＡ）」を運営している。

同氏はまた、現在停止中の金融システムに流動性を供給するためのＦＲＢによる最近の措置について、あらかじめ決められた方針があるわけではないと説明。市場の流動性を下支えする必要があると判断すれば、ＦＲＢが再びＴビルを買い入れる可能性があることを示唆した。

「準備金管理購入（ＲＭＰ） 」と呼ばれるＴビル買い入れについては、市場の流動性ニーズに応じて調整されるとも言及。Ｔビル買い入れに関して、「買い入れ額をゼロに設定するという最近の決定は、ＲＭＰが昨年１２月に始まって以降、デスクが下してきた他の判断と本質的に異なるものではない」と述べた。

さらに、ニューヨーク連銀の「準備預金の予測プロセスは頑健で、概して非常に正確だ」とし、「過去４年間の予測誤差は、準備預金供給全体のごくわずかにすぎず、当行の潤沢な準備預金の枠組みにより容易に吸収可能だ」と述べた。
